_doc: Release benchmark campaign config. See campaign.sh. est_* values are planning assumptions (sources in _src); measured rates replace them in `campaign.sh plan` as soon as tuning/perf items have run. Ours: one documented config per model (main session instruction 2026-09-29): the service unit for the 35B files, each other model's documented best config, same binary. Restructured 2026-09-29 (user): llama.cpp phase first, ours after the prefill fix; 20-min windows, one model each; 2 reps (+1 when the pair's spread > 3%); 4k/13k everywhere, 28k for the 35B files and the 80B; q100 once per engine in the headline config; Qwen3-14B dropped; llama.cpp tuning seeded from known-good settings.
